scope: Shared development source; disposable synthetic local candidates only
implemented: Shared persistent top-bar and mobile-menu search without redirecting typing to Customers or filtering the unrelated active screen
Owner-authenticated private/no-store search of customers, estimates, invoices and jobs, including partial contact details, addresses and quoted service names/descriptions
Displayed invoice number and full ID search, including 6528C9, #6528C9 and Invoice #6528C9, with exact ID/number matches ranked first
Queries cover records beyond existing list pagination; bounded eight results per category with explicit more-matches notice
All, Customers, Estimates, Invoices and Jobs filters with icons, identifying details, primary status, service appointment time and short estimate/job IDs
Explicit pointer or arrow-key/Enter selection opens actual customer profile, exact invoice card or shared estimate/job details; Enter alone never auto-selects
Debounced cancellable reads, generation guards, immediate stale-result clearing, explicit read retry, clear/empty/loading/error states and Escape dismissal
Viewport-sized results, wrapping filters, 16px input text and separate tablet search row; existing historical-address and property feature guards retained
No persistent plaintext record index, financial mutation or customer-data rewrite

verification.routeContracts: 57/57 per four candidates, actual SQLite routes: owner auth, displayed invoice numbers/IDs/ranking, literal queries, 65-estimate pagination fixture, contacts/services, category limits, uncached failures, ownership and gated historical/property addresses
verification.builtQaNativeD1HttpsChromium: 81/81: widths 320/390/768/1366, correct invoice/job targets, keyboard customer address selection, no automatic first selection, current filter, Escape, stale/failed response handling, menu search and unchanged financial records
verification.networkIsolation: No external request dispatched or uncaught client error. Only the exact known synthetic profile map iframe is intercepted and aborted; all other outside requests remain test failures
verification.financial: 194 invoice-state and 208 customer/invoice-balance assertions per four candidates; processing-fee and public-document suites per four; final-tipping suite on LIVE candidate
verification.customerLoadRecovery: 1460/1460 mocked read/error/stale/unmount checks on LIVE candidate

limitations: This is the first universal-search integration, not completion of all Step 152 requirements
Offline indexing/search, dedicated property results, payments, notes and photo/document metadata remain future work; no new record index is persisted
SQLite existing case handling is used; full Unicode normalization is not verified
Search uses current existing invoice/estimate/customer views for authoritative opening; deleted/unavailable records use their existing focus error states
No hosted deployment or real iPhone/iPad Safari or keyboard acceptance claimed
Hosted latency root cause, deposit exceptions, broader status/notification work and other release gates remain open
nextBatch: Extend authorized search to remaining record metadata with clear record targets; design isolated encrypted offline indexing before storing customer/financial search records
